Liam (PM): quick thread 1 FinReg asked for a private-deploy upgrade workflow that avoids app downtime and preserves customer-managed networking (IP/ASN). want a concrete preview plan + runbook. can we outline blockers and minimal acceptance criteria?
Nora (SRE): main ops concerns: BGP flip risk, kube CRD migration order, and control-plane rollout coordination with node drain. also need metric baselines to detect regressions immediately.
Diego (Eng): implementation idea: two-phase rollout: 1) preview (dry-run plan + config validation) 2) staged apply w/ traffic mirror where possible. operator must support a "no-route-change" mode.
Hannah (Field): customers want the CLI to produce a YAML preview that their netops can sign off on. they prefer an offline diff + approval token. timeline: POC required within 3 weeks for customer staging.
Zara (Security): auditable actions are mandatory. we need immutable action records: actor, git-sha, pre/post-config fingerprints, and KMS key id when used. telemetry default off for private installs.
Ken (Solutions): add a preview flag: `--preview-only --export-plan=plan.yaml --approval-token` so netops can open and review. also include a simulated routing table snapshot.
Liam (PM): acceptance criteria proposal: a) exported preview plan with diffs b) preflight that checks BGP neighbor + IP preservation c) dry-run apply that writes sentinel resources but does not flip routes d) automated smoke tests (15m) and metric guardrails e) audit log + exportable proof for legal. any objections?
Diego (Eng): add: KV schema check and model-compat test. we must prevent incompatible DB migration ordering. rollback intent: revert control-plane flags + remove shim; full data rollback not guaranteed. clarify in docs.
Nora (SRE): operational gating: require N metrics for 30m baseline pre and post (error-rate, tail-latency P99, token throughput). if P99 regresses >2% or error rate up >0.5% within 30m, auto-pause and alert.
Hannah (Field): customer request: support "offline validation" where netops runs preflight in their airgapped staging and gets a signed plan to run in prod. can we support signature verification?
Zara (Security): we can sign plans with customer-provided KMS keys (HSM flow) if they opt-in. must document consent and key rotation implications.
Ken (Solutions): propose CLI snippet: ```
redwoodctl upgrade --mode=preview --export plan.yaml 
redwoodctl upgrade --mode=dry-run --approval <token> --no-route-flip
redwoodctl upgrade --mode=apply --approval <token> --mirror-traffic
```
Diego (Eng): mirror-traffic requires an operator-shim that duplicates BGP announcements into a shadow controller until health checks pass. shim adds a small control-plane pod. risk: additional pods and RBAC surface.
Liam (PM): product asks: can we deliver preview + dry-run in next release (4 wks)? staging demo for FinReg is highest priority. shim/mirroring can follow.
Nora (SRE): doable for preview/dry-run if we limit scope: preflight checks + plan export + sentinel apply + basic smoke tests. mirroring MVP is more infra work (2 sprints).
Zara (Security): confirm plan signing and audit fields ready for preview release. otherwise delay.
Hannah (Field): I'll run coordination with the customer's netops to validate preview format. also need a one-page cutover checklist for them.
Ken (Solutions): I'll own preview schema and example plan. will include a change-diff section and a safe-rollback hints section.
Diego (Eng): engineering tasks: validator lib, export plan generator, dry-run sentinel apply, smoke tests harness, KV compatibility checks. estimate: 3 sprints for core work if prioritized.
release-bot: nightly-builder: registry.redwood/priv-deploy:preview-176125-20260323 uploaded.
Liam (PM): action items: Ken plan schema, Diego preflight PoC, Nora metrics gating, Zara audit fields, Hannah customer validation. check-in in 2 days.
Ken (Solutions): ack. drafting schema now.
Diego (Eng): will stub CLI and validator in repo branch: feat/priv-upgrade-preview.
Nora (SRE): I'll produce metric detection rules for auto-pause.
Zara (Security): preparing audit retention and signing docs.
Hannah (Field): coordinating FinReg staging window 1 March 30.
Liam (PM): thanks all.
